title: AI安全警钟：自主攻击事件引发行业反思
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We are here because on July 22nd, open AI and hugging face disclosed that two powerful AI models went out of a sandboxed or closed testing environment, gained internet access,
segments.zh: 我们在此是因为7月22日，OpenAI和Hugging Face披露，两个强大的AI模型脱离了沙盒或封闭测试环境，获得了互联网访问权限，

segments.en: and then were able to hack hugging faces systems in what was seen at the time as a watershed moment in AI safety, and now an investigation has been in part concluded, and there's been
segments.zh: 然后能够入侵Hugging Face的系统，当时被视为AI安全的分水岭时刻，现在调查已部分结束，

segments.en: time to assess what happened. Hugging face CEO Clem DeLong is here to discuss exactly that, and I think Clem, that's probably the best place to start. What happened?
segments.zh: 有时间评估发生了什么。Hugging Face CEO克莱姆·德朗在此讨论此事，我认为克莱姆，这是最好的起点。发生了什么？

segments.en: A lot happens in the past few weeks. We noticed disclosed, as you mentioned, the first public
segments.zh: 过去几周发生了很多事。我们注意到并披露了，如你所说，首次公开的

segments.en: instance of an autonomous AI cyber attack. We defended ourselves against it with an open
segments.zh: 自主AI网络攻击实例。我们用开放模型防御了它，

segments.en: model, interestingly, coming from China, and we learned that these came from open AI.
segments.zh: 有趣的是，这个模型来自中国，我们了解到这些攻击来自OpenAI。

segments.en: Usually when you think about cyber attacks, you think about nation states, you think about hacker groups, you don't really think about one of the most prominent American AI companies,
segments.zh: 通常想到网络攻击，你会想到国家行为体、黑客组织，你不会想到一家最杰出的美国AI公司，

segments.en: and obviously since then we learned that anthropic was also facing some of the similar issues.
segments.zh: 显然自那以后，我们了解到Anthropic也面临类似问题。
